children: 22nd Century reported mid-year progress highlighting improved gross margin focus, ~2,000 retail outlets today and a plan for ~5,000 by year-end.
Company reports ~2,000 retail outlets carrying its brands today, targeting ~5,000 outlets by year-end to broaden distribution.
Same-store sales rising monthly; VLN trial converted to carton purchases with average volume growth ~10% per month in non-promo periods.
Shift toward branded Pinnacle and VLN products to improve revenue economics and drive higher gross margin beginning in Q3 2026.
Plans include California and metro New York/NJ retail trials, a Q4 2026 direct-to-consumer home delivery platform, and further distribution announcements.
Company positions itself to address an estimated >$50 billion U.S. combustible cigarette market as the only low-nicotine combustible product authorized by FDA.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: 22nd Century Reports Mid-Year Update: 2,000 Outlets now, ~5,000 by Year-End; Improving Gross Margin
